scenes.text: In Minnesota, there is a room so quiet that nobody has ever been able to stay inside for more than forty-five minutes.
It is called an anechoic chamber, and it absorbs ninety-nine point nine percent of all sound.
First, you will hear your own heartbeat pounding in your ears, followed by your lungs expanding and even your stomach digesting.
Would you dare to spend an hour inside this silent room? Tell me in the comments.
